job.title: Software Engineer - Sr Consultant level
job.pay_full: $172,100 – $275,800 a year (US estimated salary range, may include potential sales incentive payments if applicable); may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa's Technology Organization runs processing networks that handle more than 65,000 secure transactions a second across 80 million merchants and 15,000 financial institutions. This role joins the Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) organization as a senior staff-level engineer focused on using AI to solve engineering and customer challenges: improving developer productivity and customer experiences, and driving next-generation commercial payment and money movement technology for B2B, B2C, P2P and G2C flows.
duties: Design and architect AI-powered solutions for engineering productivity and customer-facing products across CMS
Lead technical initiatives using agentic AI, LLMs and machine learning to automate workflows and improve software quality
Work across functions to create design artifacts and build software for several Visa offerings
Drive experimentation with emerging AI technologies and make decisions on adoption and standards
Build scalable platforms and services that bring AI into Visa's commercial payment and money movement systems
Work with product owners to gather and refine requirements, and deliver new features end to end
Contribute to technical documentation and mentoring
needs: 8+ years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree, or at least 5 years with an advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD), or 2 years with a PhD, or 11+ years of relevant work experience
nice: 9+ years with a bachelor's degree, 7+ with an advanced degree or 3+ with a PhD

A master's in math, science, engineering, computer science, information systems or a related field with 6+ years of directly related experience, a bachelor's in those fields with 8+ years, or 11+ years of directly related experience
Experience with AI agent frameworks, LLMs or generative AI applications, and AI-powered development tools
Applying AI to engineering challenges or customer-facing features
Understanding of commercial payments, money movement, B2B payables or payment processing
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), API design, microservices and distributed systems
Expertise in a general development language such as Java, C# or C++
details.benefits: Estimated US salary range $172,100 – $275,800 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable); pay depends on knowledge, skills, experience and location, and the role may be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa's benefits package may include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: Hybrid: at least 3 days in the office, with expectations confirmed by the hiring manager
Visa says it does not expect any single candidate to have every listed skill
